Method of Attack: Using Google Ads admin interface to send bulk email invitations that bypass recipient spam filters
Emails contain spam links redirecting to adult dating and sex websites designed to collect personal information
Impacted Systems: Users receiving Google Ads email invitations
Attack Vector: Email invitations sent from official Google Ads email address
Indicators of Compromise: Emails sent from official Google address 'Google Ads ads-account-noreply@google.com'
URLs in invite emails redirecting to dodgy adult dating websites
